name: AWS Amplify Hosting
line: Build, deploy, and deliver full-stack web apps from Git.

free.text: Up to $200 credits; six months or until credits run out

work.math: 20 builds of 5 minutes each at $0.01 a minute, plus 100 GB of delivery at $0.15 per GB = $16 a month. Stored deployment storage (GB-months) is not included.
$16.30, plus $13.8888888889 for each billed GB of memory, plus $0.023 per GB a month for stored deployments, plus logs. Both the memory and storage amounts are unknown.
Hosting uses the small app API's unknown memory and storage formula. Postgres adds unverified RDS database compute, 20 GiB of storage, backups and network charges.
